verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Found in Your hands, fullness of joy
Every fear suddenly wiped away
Here in Your presence

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All of my gains now fade away
Every crown no longer on display
Here in Your presence

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Heaven is trembling
In awe of Your wonders

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
The kings and their kingdoms
Are standing amazed

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Here in Your presence
We are undone
Here in Your presence
Heaven and Earth become one

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Here in Your presence
All things are new
Here in Your presence
Everything bows before You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Wonderful, beautiful, glorious
Matchless in every way
Wonderful, beautiful, glorious
Matchless in every way
